subject: Fix invalid escape sequence in utils, minor cleanup in python script  (#948)
reason: The change edits only utils/generate-unit-test-header.py, a build-time Python helper that generates the unit-test header: it makes the TEST_PROTOTYPE regex a raw string to fix a Python invalid-escape-sequence warning. The regex matches the same patterns as before, and no server, replication, persistence, command, or tool code path changes, so there is no runtime behaviour for a fuzzer scenario to reach.
